attempts.rationale: Test weighted combination with inverse_error weights, as the diagnosis suggests weighted and the series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability.
test a different strategy type (dba) on the full pool because weighted is already used and we need a distinct approach.
The series is trend-dominated with high predictability; a robust aggregator like trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
The series has a strong trend and low seasonality; a simple mean over all models might capture the trend without overfitting to noise, offering a different strategy type from weighted.
test a different weighted scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if concentration improves on this trend-dominated series.
trend-dominated with moderate ranking; try per-horizon best weights to capture any horizon shifts.
Test a non-weighted, non-mean strategy (median) to see if a robust central tendency helps for this trend-dominated series.
use inverse error on the top‑5 models to exploit the trend dominance and reduce variance
test softmax weighting on the top‑5 pool
compare plain mean on correlated top‑5 models
test dba on the top‑5 correlated models
trend_dominated series with moderate ranking suggests a robust central tendency; try median on the top‑5 pool to see if it beats weighted.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.2714. Series context: trend strength 0.9868 and seasonal strength 0.05; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.485); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 33.959.
